definitions.explanation: A game of throwing snowballs at one another, usually in two sides. {合戦|かっせん} (battle) becomes がっせん in the compound. In Japan there is also a competitive team sport with this name, played with rules, shelters and pre-made snowballs.

examples.japanese: {雪合戦|ゆきがっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雪合戦|ゆきがっせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a snowball fight with my friends in the schoolyard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}もった→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{雪合戦|ゆきがっせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧だ。
examples.english: Snow has settled for the first time in ages, so the children have been absorbed in snowball fights since morning.
